question: Under which List of the Indian Constitution are co-operative societies classified?
solution:
The correct answer is __**State List**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Co-operative societies** are classified under the **State List** of the Indian Constitution as per Entry 32 of List II in the Seventh Schedule.
 
• This classification empowers state governments to legislate on matters related to co-operative societies within their respective jurisdictions.
